Instructions: 1. Find the column for the model of outdoor unit that is being installed. 2. Find the row for the model of the indoor unit that is being installed. 3. Find the cell in the table in which this row and column meet. In this cell the appropriate orifice / TXV and charge addition for this match are listed. If the text in this cell is BOLD, then a change of orifice is necessary. 4. If a change in restrictor is necessary, then the appropriate restrictor will already be supplied with the outdoor unit. Examples: • For the *SA(1,2)BD4M1SN30K / C7B(A,H)M03036(C,U)-B the appropriate restrictor is 0.061 and no additional refrigerant will need to be added.
